note: Do not hard-code tolerances in checks. Values are millimetres, mm^3 or relative fractions. per_os entries override default (platform.system()). thickness.* values were measured on the analytic fixtures; see test_verify_thickness.py.

thickness_measured.note: Measured on macOS arm64, OCCT of the baseline build b4fcc8e, samples=5 and 9. thickness_abs_mm is set ~1e11 above the measured error to absorb cross-OS float differences; the check is exact for plates, tubes, shells and sphere shells because rays are normal to both walls. No claim is made for freeform or non-parallel walls.
